# Most Frequent Even Element. -1 means that nums holds no even value.

@example 6 has three valid votes and 8 has two; the three votes for 3 are thrown out.
[8,3,6,3,8,3,6,6]
=> 6

@example 10 and 4 tie with two votes each, and 4 is smaller, though 10 comes first.
[10,7,4,10,4]
=> 4

@example Every vote is for an odd number.
[11,5,11]
=> -1

# A single entry: 0, which is even.
[0]
=> 0

# A single entry, odd: the largest odd value allowed.
[99999]
=> -1

# 0 wins a three-way tie with larger even values.
[6,0,2,6,0,2]
=> 0

# 0 is the even value with the most votes.
[100000,0,3,3,3,0]
=> 0

# The largest value allowed, 10^5, wins.
[100000,99999,100000,2]
=> 100000

# The odd value has the most votes overall, but they don't count.
[7,7,7,7,12]
=> 12

# A three-way tie whose smallest value comes last.
[40,30,40,30,1,20,20]
=> 20

# Every even value has one vote: the smallest of them, in the middle, wins.
[50,3,48,9,52]
=> 48

# The only even value is the last entry.
[9,13,9,13,9,64]
=> 64
